## Branch checklist

- [ ] Branched from latest `develop`
- [ ] Branch name follows convention (`feature/`, `fix/`, `test/`, `docs/`, `chore/`, `refactor/`)
- [ ] Commits are small and use `type: description` messages (no `update`, `fix`, `final`, ...)
- [ ] `./gradlew checkstyleMain` and `./gradlew pmdMain` pass locally
- [ ] `./gradlew test` passes locally
- [ ] Reviewed by at least one teammate before merging into `develop`
